exposure: Heart rate measurement using a new wireless fabric jacket (ComfTech HOWDY)
Heart rate measurement using standard ECG (Vita Guard VG 3100)
outcome: Agreement of heart rate measurements between the new device and standard ECG
cohort: Newborns born at >=35+0 weeks of gestation with an Apgar score >8 at 5 minutes, excluding infants needing resuscitation, having clinical instability, or major malformations.
finding: The new wireless device (ComfTech HOWDY) showed reliable agreement with standard ECG measurements, with a mean difference of -1.3 bpm.
cross-section timing: Heart rate was assessed simultaneously by both devices within 20 minutes after birth and compared at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after birth.
